fact_text: Bank of Punjab reported Q3 2025 earnings per share of PKR 1.57, up 43% year on year and about 3% on the previous quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Bank of Punjab announced no dividend with its Q3 2025 results, although a corporate briefing had signalled a quarterly payout, and the shares fell on the news.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Bank of Punjab's Q3 2025 net interest income rose 9% quarter on quarter to PKR 2.6 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Bank of Punjab booked a credit loss allowance of PKR 1.76 billion in Q3 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Bank of Punjab's fee, commission and brokerage income rose 16% quarter on quarter to PKR 3.56 billion in Q3 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Bank of Punjab's deposits grew about 20% year on year to Q3 2025, mostly from low-cost CASA deposits, which lifted the CASA share to roughly 23-24% of total deposits from about 20% a year earlier.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Management had said it was repricing expensive term deposits, and the presenter saw net interest margin improve in Q3 2025 as a result.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: The minimum deposit rate requirement, which had applied even to corporate deposits, was removed from January 2025, so banks can offer lower deposit rates.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Bank of Punjab's infection ratio (non-performing loans) was about 6.5%, and the bank booked provisions for loans it classifies as underperforming or non-performing under IFRS 9.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Bank of Punjab's capital adequacy ratio was 17.43%, well above the regulatory requirement.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Bank of Punjab's book value per share was about PKR 30 in its latest balance sheet.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: The presenter judged Bank of Punjab, trading below PKR 35, to be at about 1.1 times book value on his expected book value of about PKR 32.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: The presenter expected Bank of Punjab's capital gains to stay low, with high-yield investments held to maturity, so his conservative view treats the Q3 EPS level as sustainable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: The presenter thought Bank of Punjab's earnings could sustain about PKR 1.5 per quarter, with full-year 2025 EPS of about PKR 5 to 6.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: The presenter expected Bank of Punjab could pay a further PKR 1 to 1.5 dividend in its final quarter after having paid PKR 1 earlier in the year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Cherat Cement's Q1 FY26 earnings per share were PKR 10.79, down 27% year on year and up 13% quarter on quarter, ahead of market expectations.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Cherat Cement's Q1 FY26 net sales were PKR 10.3 billion, up 6% quarter on quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Cherat Cement's finance cost fell 39% year on year to PKR 348 million in Q1 FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Cherat Cement's gross margin was about 36% in Q1 FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Local and export dispatches of Cherat Cement rose about 8% in Q1 FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: The presenter linked Cherat's higher gross margin to a shift in its power mix toward renewables, and said the margin may not be sustained because its effective coal cost had risen.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: International coal prices fell from about USD 95 to about USD 80 per ton, but local and Afghan coal prices rose, so the effective weighted coal cost for cement makers increased after September 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Cement prices fell after September 2025, and there was market talk that they could be repriced upward, which would support cement margins.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: The presenter estimated Cherat's FY26 EPS at about PKR 37-38, and possibly about PKR 40 if cement prices rise, with winter working hours reducing output.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Cherat Cement did not complete its planned acquisition of Rafhan Maize, and it also withdrew from buying Attock Cement with the Shirazi group.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Cherat Cement held about PKR 14 billion of cash in Q1 FY26 and its capacity utilisation was about 55%, so it had no expansion plan at that time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: The presenter said Cherat prioritises projects with high returns on equity; an Attock Cement purchase at market price would take 8-9 years to pay back, while he wanted projects paying back in 4-5 years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: The presenter said Cherat's cost-optimisation focus includes renewable energy investment and occasionally using pet coke in place of coal when that is cheaper.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Engro Holdings reported Q3 2025 EPS of PKR 5.35, down from PKR 28.2 in Q2 2025, which included a one-off from reclassifying thermal energy assets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Engro Holdings announced no dividend with its Q3 2025 results, and its shares fell after the results.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Engro Holdings' energy assets, Sindh Engro Coal Mining, Engro Thar and Engro Powergen Qadirpur, were treated as discontinued operations, then reclassified back to continuing operations after the planned sale did not go through.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Engro Holdings acquired the tower business spun off from Jazz, held under the Dewdar name, with the transaction effective 3 June 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Engro financed the tower business acquisition with a loan of about PKR 100 billion and about PKR 60 billion of equity, part of which is payable over two years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: Engro's effective tax rate on its LNG business rose from 9% in FY25 to 15% in FY26, and on its tower business from 4% to 6%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: The tower business made a cash profit in its first three months, though its accounting profit was lower because of depreciation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: The presenter ranked Engro Holdings' profit contributors as fertiliser first, energy assets second and the tower business third, with the tower business contributing about 10-15% of profitability.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: The presenter expected only a nominal dividend in FY25 and FY26 as tower-deal debt and equity payments take priority, with a better dividend expected from 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)

fact_text: The presenter estimated Engro Holdings' EPS at about PKR 25 for 2026 and PKR 30-35 for 2027, implying a price-to-earnings multiple of roughly 6-8 times.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of BOP CHCC & ENGROH | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-05)
